channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Old documents a treasure trove of history
item.description: A trove of 19th- and early 20th-century papers from Jack and Cassie Sherrod, Black farmers near Stantonsburg, is shedding light on family life and landownership.

item.title: Thank you, SCOTUS
item.description: A retired pastor reflects on a Supreme Court ruling curbing Trump's tariff plans, arguing it signals waning power for a “mad king” and growing backlash to his cruelty and anti-democratic tendencies.

item.title: Ruling could lighten Carolinians’ load
item.description: A Supreme Court ruling curbs Trump's emergency tariffs, and this column argues a new 15% import tax is illegal and could be blocked, easing costs and retaliation risks for North Carolina consumers and exporters.

item.title: Hope on the Hill: What 80 North Carolina educators discovered in DC
item.description: On a trip to Capitol Hill, 80 North Carolina educators found active, bipartisan engagement on education and returned with a renewed push for constituents to advocate and vote for their public schools.

item.title: Paying today for a hamburger tomorrow
item.description: With home values and county revenues rising, North Carolina lawmakers debate caps and other property tax reforms, but election-year politics may delay significant changes.

item.title: Wilson City Council to discuss limits on ICE cooperation
item.description: An email from Councilman Eduardo Herrera-Picasso to Mayor Carlton Stevens on how Wilson should respond to ICE operations has sparked fears online of Wilson becoming a "sanctuary city." Council members will discuss the email's contents at their March 5 breakfast meeting.

item.title: Area Calendar, Feb. 26-27, 2026
item.description: Area sports calendar: NCHSAA basketball playoffs lead a full slate of high school and Barton College games Feb. 26-27, including baseball, softball, soccer, tennis, lacrosse and more.

item.title: Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week: Elizabeth Morgan, North Johnston High
item.description: North Johnston senior guard Elizabeth Morgan earns Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week after leading a tournament title run while balancing a 4.4 GPA and community work.

item.title: After losing his parents, Olympian Naumov skates for his 'why'
item.description: After losing his Olympian parents in a 2025 plane crash, figure skater Maxim Naumov returns to the ice, inspiring a reflection on grief, purpose and finding a personal “why” in sport and work.

item.title: Warriors’ Gibson eager to be a Bulldog
item.description: Hunt High’s three-year starting center James Gibson, a key leader in the Warriors’ 5-A state finals run, signs with Barton College, citing faith, coaching and a chance to fulfill his college football dream.
